# Helix Intelligence

> Competitor ad research for Meta. Search the Meta Ad Library for a brand,
> see which of its ads have run the longest, watch a search for changes, and
> save ads into boards. Invite-only: an administrator grants access per
> workspace. There is no pricing page, trial or checkout.

## What exists

- Discover: search the Meta Ad Library for a brand or domain. Results are
  sorted by how many days each ad has been running. Run length is "unknown"
  when the source does not report a start date; it is never shown as 0.
  Longevity presets (30, 60, 90+ days) filter stored results. The score shown
  is a rubric of the ad text only, not a performance prediction. Reach is
  shown only when it comes from Meta's official Ad Library API.
- Monitors: re-run a saved Discover search on a schedule and list new,
  stopped and rewritten ads since the previous run.
- Boards: save ads into named boards inside a workspace.

## What does not exist

- No Google, TikTok or other ad libraries. Meta only.
- No AI-generated ads or creative generation.
- No access to your own ad accounts or their performance.
- No public write API. Nothing outside the signed-in web app can create,
  change or delete data.
